note: Every data and scenario source the plan names, with the verbatim fragment of its licence or terms and its redistribution class (research dossier 08, the master matrix; SGCD from dossier 07). A source whose licence is UNVERIFIED keeps the class the research could support and lists the open question. A link-only or unusable source is linked, never read by a case. Fetch specifications are added by the unit that first reads the source, after the download is verified.

classes.mirror-allowed: raw rows may be committed or re-hosted, with attribution where required
classes.derived-only: raw data may be downloaded by the pipeline; only aggregates, fitted parameters and results derived from it are committed and replayed
classes.link-only: fetched at run time from the publisher at most; neither raw rows nor substantial derived extracts are redistributed; the web only links
classes.unusable: the terms forbid the intended use, or the data is not publicly obtainable
